about.title: About us
about.intro: We build elegant landing pages for professional affiliate marketers.

sections.p: Affiliate marketers spend their time finding great products and writing honest reviews. We give them a premium page with their own name that gathers all their picks from the world’s biggest stores, with short reviews that build trust and raise conversions.
Design, speed, mobile layout, search engine optimisation and click tracking. You focus on choosing products and writing reviews.
Visitors are sent straight to your own affiliate link. We never replace your tracking tag and we never take a share of your commissions.

faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.intro: Everything you need to know before you start.

sections.p: A platform for affiliate marketers. You create a luxury landing page with your name that shows your offers from Amazon, Walmart, Target and other stores. Each product gets a review page and a buy button that sends visitors to your affiliate link.

sections.h: How do I get my page link?
sections.p: When you sign up you choose your page name and link, for example yoursite.com/your-name. You can change it later from Page design in your dashboard.

sections.h: Does the platform take part of my commission?
sections.p: No. Visitors go directly to the affiliate link you added, and the store pays your commission under its own program.

sections.h: Can I see how many clicks I get?
sections.p: Yes. Your dashboard shows views, clicks and click-through rate for every offer and for the last 30 days.

sections.h: Do I need an affiliate disclosure?
sections.p: Programs such as Amazon Associates and FTC rules require it, so a disclosure appears by default at the bottom of your page. You can edit its text.
Your page can be in English, Arabic or French, with full right-to-left layout for Arabic.

help.title: Help center
help.intro: Quick answers for using your dashboard.

sections.p: Open your dashboard and choose Add offer. Paste your affiliate link (we detect the store automatically), add the title, photos and a short review, then publish.
On the Offers page use the arrows to reorder, then save the order. Offers marked with a star appear at the top of your page.
In Page design change the theme, accent color, avatar, cover, social links and the language of your page.
The overview shows daily views and clicks for the last 30 days and your best performing offers.
Contact us from the Contact page and we will get back to you quickly.

terms.title: Terms of use
terms.intro: By using the platform you agree to these terms.

sections.p: You are responsible for the information in your account and for keeping your password safe.

You must publish honest information about products, respect the terms of the affiliate programs you join (such as Amazon Associates, Walmart Affiliates or Target Partners) and display an affiliate disclosure.
Using trademarks or images without the right to do so, or publishing misleading or illegal content, is not allowed.
We may suspend or close any page or account that breaks these terms.
We may update these terms. Continuing to use the platform means you accept the updated version.

privacy.title: Privacy policy
privacy.intro: We respect your privacy and protect your personal data.

sections.p: We keep your account data (name and email) to run your dashboard.
We only record aggregated statistics (daily views and clicks) without storing personal data about visitors.
When a visitor clicks a buy button they are sent to the store’s website, where that store’s privacy policy applies.
You can ask us to delete your data at any time by contacting us.

cookies.title: Cookie policy
cookies.intro: We use as few cookies as possible.

sections.p: We use a session cookie to keep you logged in to your dashboard, and a cookie to remember your language.
We do not place advertising or tracking cookies of our own on marketer pages.
When a visitor follows an affiliate link, the store may set its own cookies to credit the sale to the marketer. Those cookies are controlled by the store.
You can delete or block cookies in your browser settings. Blocking essential cookies will log you out.

disclosure.title: Affiliate disclosure
disclosure.intro: How affiliate links work on pages hosted here.

sections.p: Pages created on the platform are run by independent marketers. When you buy through their links, they may earn a commission at no extra cost to you.
Prices and availability are set by the store and can change at any time. Always check the final price on the store’s website.
Reviews are the opinion of each marketer. The platform does not sell products and is not affiliated with the stores shown.
Store names and logos belong to their owners and are used only to identify where a product is sold.

acceptableUse.title: Acceptable use
acceptableUse.intro: Rules that keep the platform trusted by visitors and stores.

sections.p: Do not publish fake reviews, fake discounts or false claims about products.
Respect the rules of every affiliate program you use, including rules about how prices and logos may be shown.
Do not promote illegal, dangerous or adult products, or anything the store itself forbids.
Do not use the platform for spam, phishing, malware or to impersonate another person or brand.

contact.title: Contact us
contact.intro: Questions, feedback or partnership ideas? We would love to hear from you.

sections.p: For help with your account or dashboard, write to us and include the link of your page.
If you find a page that breaks our rules, send us its link and we will review it.

guide.title: Affiliate marketing guide
guide.intro: Launch a page that converts in six steps.

sections.p: Apply to programs such as Amazon Associates, Walmart Affiliates and Target Partners. Each one gives you links that include your tracking tag.
Pages focused on one audience (tech, home, beauty, fitness…) earn more trust than pages that mix everything.
Prefer products with strong ratings, fair prices and good availability. Fewer, better picks convert better.
Explain who the product is for, list real pros and cons and give a clear verdict. Honesty sells.
Put your page link in your bio, video descriptions, posts and newsletters.
Check your dashboard each week. Move your best offers to the top and replace those that get no clicks.
